overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an insufficiently specific July 9, 2024 notice that omitted the names of individuals considered for appointment; the posting-location claim was rejected.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the July 9, 2024 notice was not posted to townofmiddleton.org, the notice posting location then on file with the AG.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law where the notice was timely posted to middletonma.gov, the official posting location for all public bodies in the Town of Middleton.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the July 9, 2024 notice omitted names of candidates for the Library Board of Trustees and the identity of the 'new appointments.'
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the notice should have included the names of the individuals being considered for appointment to the Library Board of Trustees, Bylaw Review Committee, Historical Commission, Rails to Trail Committee, and Affordable Housing Trust.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
